cards.front: Parece haber unos problemas en su matrimonio (de ellos).
cards.back: There seem to be some problems in their marriage.

cards.front: No parece ocurrir nada malo con tu lavadora.
cards.back: There doesn't seem to be anything wrong with your washing machine.

cards.front: ¿Parece haber un aumento en el número de desastres naturales en los últimos años?
cards.back: Does there seem to be an increase in the number of natural disasters in recent years?

cards.front: Tiende a registrarse una caída en la tasa de desempleo en los meses de verano.
cards.back: There tends to be a drop in the unemployment rate in the summer months.

cards.front: No se suele tener mucha compasión con los fumadores que tienen problemas de salud.
cards.back: There doesn't tend to be much sympathy for smokers who have health problems.

cards.front: ¿Suele haber más mujeres que estudian publicidad y periodismo?
cards.back: Do there tend to be more women studying advertising and journalism?

cards.front: Es probable que haya fuertes protestas cuando anunciemos esta decisión.
cards.back: There's likely to be an outcry when we announce this decision.

cards.front: Es probable que no haya mucha gente en el concierto.
cards.back: There aren't likely to be many people at the concert.

cards.front: ¿Es probable que haya otros despidos el próximo viernes?
cards.back: Are there likely to be other layoffs next Friday?

cards.front: Es seguro que habrá problemas cuando reciban la factura.
cards.back: There is sure to be trouble when they receive the bill.

cards.front: No estoy de acuerdo; no es seguro que vaya a haber una subida en la tasa de inflación.
cards.back: I don't agree; there isn't certain to be a rise in the inflation rate.

cards.front: ¿Es seguro que habrá barra libre en su boda (de ellos)?
cards.back: Is there sure to be a free bar at their wedding?

cards.front: Seguro que habrá alguien allí cuando lleguemos.
cards.back: There's bound to be someone there when we arrive.

cards.front: No es verdad, no es seguro que vaya a haber despidos en un futuro próximo.
cards.back: That's not true, there aren't bound to be layoffs in the near future.

cards.front: Eso es un poco pesimista. ¿Por qué crees que es seguro que habrá una tercera guerra mundial?
cards.back: That's a bit pessimistic. Why do you think there's bound to be a third world war?

cards.front: Me puse contentísimo cuando mi mujer me dijo que estaba embarazada.
cards.back: I was thrilled to bits when my wife told me she was pregnant.

cards.front: ¿Te pusiste muy contento cuando por fin la conociste?
cards.back: Were you thrilled to bits when you finally met her?

cards.front: Me haría mucha ilusión si pudieras venir a mi fiesta.
cards.back: I'd be thrilled to bits if you could come to my party.

cards.front: Estaba la mar de contento cuando me contaron la noticia.
cards.back: I was really chuffed when they told me the news.

cards.front: No diría que se puso loca de contenta al vernos.
cards.back: She wasn't exactly chuffed to see us.

cards.front: No encuentro palabras para expresarte lo contento que me puse cuando me dieron el premio.
cards.back: I can't tell you how chuffed I was when they awarded me the prize.

cards.front: ¿No ves que está en las nubes cuando hablas con él?
cards.back: Can't you see he's on cloud nine whenever you speak to him?

cards.front: Estaba en el séptimo cielo la primera vez que ella me besó.
cards.back: I was in seventh heaven the first time she kissed me.

cards.front: Estaremos todos en las nubes si ganamos este contrato.
cards.back: We'll all be on cloud nine if we win this contract.

cards.front: Toda España estaba loca de contenta cuando ganó el Mundial.
cards.back: The whole of Spain was over the moon when they won the World Cup.

cards.front: Se puso loco de contento cuando ella le dijo que se casaría con él.
cards.back: He was over the moon when she said she would marry him.

cards.front: ¡Pareces loca de contenta!
cards.back: You look like you're over the moon!

cards.front: Estaba encantado de ver a mis padres en el concierto.
cards.back: I was tickled pink to see my parents at the concert.

cards.front: Tenías que haberle visto la cara; ¡estaba la mar de contento!
cards.back: You should have seen his face; he was tickled pink!

cards.front: No puedo creer que haya aprobado todos mis exámenes; ¡estoy contentísimo!
cards.back: I can't believe I've passed all my exams; I'm tickled pink!

cards.front: Podrías pedirles un préstamo; están forrados.
cards.back: You could ask them for a loan; they're loaded.

cards.front: Ojalá estuviera tan forrada como ella.
cards.back: I wish I were as loaded as she is.

cards.front: No me mires a mí para el dinero; ¡no estoy forrado, sabes!
cards.back: Don't look at me for the money; I'm not loaded, you know!

cards.front: No me preocuparía por lo que vayas a pedir para cenar; pagan ellos y están forrados.
cards.back: I wouldn't worry about what you order for dinner; they're paying and they're rolling in it.

cards.front: No puedo creer que invirtieran en esa empresa; deben de estar forrados.
cards.back: I can't believe they invested in that company; they must be rolling in it.

cards.front: ¿Qué crees, que estoy forrado?
cards.back: What do you think, that I'm rolling in it?

cards.front: No puedo salir este fin de semana; estoy pelado.
cards.back: I can't go out this weekend; I'm broke.

cards.front: Le gusta vestirse bien, pero en realidad está sin un duro.
cards.back: He likes to dress very well, but he's actually completely broke.

cards.front: ¿Qué quieres decir con «estamos pelados»? ¿No nos quedan ahorros?
cards.back: What do you mean by "we're broke"? Don't we have any savings left?

cards.front: Yo esperaría antes de comprar una casa; los precios siguen por las nubes.
cards.back: I'd wait before buying a house, prices are still sky high.

cards.front: El precio que pagué por el tratamiento médico en los Estados Unidos estaba por las nubes.
cards.back: I had to pay a sky high bill for the medical treatment I received in the US.

cards.front: Sus primas de seguro están por las nubes.
cards.back: Their insurance premiums are sky high.

cards.front: Yo que tú compraría; esas acciones están baratísimas.
cards.back: I'd buy if I were you; those shares are dirt cheap.

cards.front: No digas que está baratísimo, ¡di que tiene buena relación calidad-precio!
cards.back: Don't call it dirt cheap; call it value-for-money!

cards.front: Encontré este reloj en eBay; ¡estaba regalado!
cards.back: I found this watch on eBay; it was dirt cheap!

cards.front: No me acosté en toda la noche porque estaba trabajando.
cards.back: I was up all night working.

cards.front: ¿Se ha levantado ya (él)?
cards.back: Is he up yet?

cards.front: Ya que estás de pie, ¿me puedes traer el mando?
cards.back: While you're up, can you get me the remote control?

cards.front: ¿Te apetece echar un partido de tenis?
cards.back: Are you up for a game of tennis?

cards.front: No creo que él tenga ganas de salir otra vez.
cards.back: I don't think he's up for going out again.

cards.front: Ella se apunta a un bombardeo.
cards.back: She's always up for anything.

cards.front: Él no está a la altura de este trabajo; me temo que tendremos que despedirle.
cards.back: He's not up to this job; I'm afraid we're going to have to let him go.

cards.front: No está a su nivel (de él) de siempre.
cards.back: It isn't up to his usual standard.

cards.front: Ella no estaba en condiciones de ir al trabajo hoy.
cards.back: She wasn't up to going into work today.

cards.front: ¿Qué están tramando esos niños?
cards.back: What are those kids up to?

cards.front: Creo que él está tramando algo.
cards.back: I think he's up to something.

cards.front: Ellos no andan metidos en nada bueno, como siempre.
cards.back: They're up to no good, as usual.

cards.front: Si de mí dependiera, yo no lo haría.
cards.back: If it were up to me, I wouldn't do it.

cards.front: Te toca decidir a ti.
cards.back: It's up to you to decide.

cards.front: Creo que les corresponde a ellos decírmelo.
cards.back: I think it is up to them to tell me.

cards.front: Me alegro que los dos estéis juntos ahora, ¡llevabas siglos detrás de ella!
cards.back: I'm glad you two are together now, you'd been after her for ages!

cards.front: ¿Sigue el Chelsea detrás de ese jugador?
cards.back: Is Chelsea still after that player?

cards.front: ¡Conozco a alguien que anda detrás de ti!
cards.back: I know somebody who is after you!

cards.front: Debería de estar aquí en un minuto.
cards.back: He should be along in a minute.

cards.front: No te preocupes, otro autobús llegará dentro de nada.
cards.back: Don't worry, there'll be another bus along shortly.

cards.front: Lo siento, tu comida saldrá en cinco minutos.
cards.back: I'm sorry, your food will be along in five minutes.

cards.front: Vamos a tener que ir de compras porque se nos ha acabado toda la comida.
cards.back: We're going to have to go shopping as we're completely out of food.

cards.front: ¡Ay, no! ¡No me digas que nos hemos quedado sin gasolina!
cards.back: Oh, no! Don't tell me that we're out of petrol!

cards.front: Me temo que no habéis tenido suerte; no quedan entradas.
cards.back: You're out of luck, I'm afraid; there are no tickets left.

cards.front: Ella está intentando que le despidan porque le odia.
cards.back: She is out to get him sacked because she hates him.

cards.front: Él siente que todo el mundo está en su contra.
cards.back: He feels like everyone is out to get him.

cards.front: Quieren acabar con todo el sistema financiero.
cards.back: They're out to destroy the whole financial system.

cards.front: Dilo de nuevo, creo que has dado con algo importante.
cards.back: Say that again, I think you're onto something.

cards.front: Saben que han encontrado algo que vale la pena.
cards.back: They know they're onto a good thing.

cards.front: La policía le caló en seguida.
cards.back: The police were onto him at once.

cards.front: El Primer Ministro va a visitar España en noviembre.
cards.back: The Prime Minister is to visit Spain in November.

cards.front: Los niños comerán a la una en la sala principal.
cards.back: The children are to have lunch at one o'clock in the main hall.

cards.front: Todos los empleados recibirán un aumento del tres por ciento en sus sueldos.
cards.back: All employees are to receive a three percent rise in their salaries.

cards.front: ¡Tienes que volver antes de la medianoche!
cards.back: You're to be back no later than midnight!

cards.front: ¡No volverás a ver a esos chicos jamás!
cards.back: You are not to see those boys ever again!

cards.front: Debéis terminar los deberes antes de que empecéis a jugar con los videojuegos.
cards.back: You are to do your homework before you think about playing video games.

cards.front: No sabían que volverían a encontrarse en circunstancias extrañas.
cards.back: They didn't know that they were to meet again in very strange circumstances.

cards.front: Sus acciones iban a tener serias repercusiones.
cards.back: Their actions were to have serious repercussions.

cards.front: No quiso el destino que así fuera.
cards.back: It was not to be.

cards.front: Los niños siempre tienen que ir acompañados de un adulto.
cards.back: Children are to be accompanied by an adult at all times.

cards.front: No se pueden abrir las ventanas bajo ningún concepto.
cards.back: These windows are not to be opened under any circumstances.

cards.front: Estas pastillas tienen que tomarse una por la mañana y una por la noche.
cards.back: These pills are to be taken one in the morning and one at night.

cards.front: Para tomar tres veces al día antes de las comidas.
cards.back: To be taken three times a day before meals.

cards.front: No se puede abrir hasta el día de Navidad.
cards.back: Not to be opened until Christmas day.

cards.front: Sólo oficiales del gobierno tienen permiso para verlo.
cards.back: To be seen only by government officials.
